about: Saved small-model outputs from the rewriter evaluation (scripts/rewriter-eval/run.mjs; mlx = Granite 4.0 1B, apple = the model built into macOS; final = the tuned prompts, baseline = the untuned ones), copied here (the saved files live outside the repo) so test/rewrite-check-suggest.test.js runs on a fresh clone. Each must come out of suggest mode as `expect`, with `code` among its reasons or warnings.
